market_question: Russia x Ukraine ceasefire agreement by December 31, 2026?
reasoning: Given the 21-month window until Dec 2026, there is a plausible chance of a mutual ceasefire agreement, even if temporary. The Trump administration is prioritizing an end to the conflict, and war fatigue may increase pressure on both sides. The definition requires only a general suspension of military engagement, not a permanent settlement, so the bar is lower than a full peace deal. I estimate the true probability at around 55%, versus the market's 48.5%.
evidence_points: New US administration signals urgency to broker a deal, potentially leveraging aid and sanctions.
Protracted conflicts often see temporary ceasefires due to mutual exhaustion or international mediation.
Market definition includes any mutually agreed general pause, not limited to permanent peace or territorial resolution.
sources_consulted: General knowledge of Russia-Ukraine war up to March 2025
Reports on Trump administration foreign policy statements
Historical precedent of ceasefires in frozen conflicts
